title: Experts disagree on HudVerdictRecord in src/hud/receipt-file.ts
context:
Chief architect: The two claims agree; this one carries the guardrail on a Stop-path script, which is the higher risk. The QA fixtures (other change id hidden, legacy hidden, written_at equal to latest edit shown, one millisecond earlier hidden) become the tests that prove it.

Target: HudVerdictRecord in src/hud/receipt-file.ts
- solution-architect: the new change field is written by runtime/scripts/verify-backstop.mjs, a Stop-path script; the field must be added without changing that script's decision, stdout or exit code, and legacy records without it read as no verdict
- qa-engineer: Verdict freshness needs three fixtures: verdict for another change id is hidden; a legacy record without change is hidden; verdict written_at equal to latestEditAt is shown and one millisecond earlier is hidden. The headline must never say Safe to merge in the hidden cases.
